steps: REACT→VUE CONVERSION RULES (apply to all 13 components): (1) Read the source TSX/JSX pages at .../src/pages/*.tsx or .../src/components/<Tool>.tsx — find the main interactive component (not landing/home pages). (2) Convert React hooks to Vue 3 composition API: useState(x) → const x = ref(X); useEffect(fn, []) → onMounted(fn); useEffect(fn, [dep]) → watch(dep, fn); useCallback(fn) → const fn = () => {}; useMemo(() => expr, [dep]) → computed(() => expr). (3) Convert JSX to Vue template: className → class; onClick → @click; onChange → @input or @change; htmlFor → for; {condition && <el>} → v-if; {items.map(fn)} → v-for; {variable} interpolation → {{ variable }}. (4) React Router navigate('/x') → useRouter().push('/x') or simply remove internal routing (the tool runs in-place). (5) Remove React-specific imports: React, useState, useEffect, etc. Add Vue imports: ref, computed, watch, onMounted, onUnmounted from 'vue'. (6) Remove all shadcn/ui component imports and replace with equivalent Tailwind markup (Button → <button class='...'>, Card → <div class='...'>, Input → <input class='...'>, etc.). (7) Remove lucide-react imports; replace with @iconify/vue Icon with equivalent mdi: icons. (8) Same rules for standalone stores, fonts, toast libraries not in main project. (9) Use <script setup lang="ts">. (10) Component filename: kebab-case matching slug.
